entities.summary: Carlos Falcó y Fernández de Córdoba, 5th Marquess of Griñón, GE was a Spanish peer, businessman and socialite. He was best known by his title of Marquess of Griñón despite later inheriting a much older title, Marquess of Castel-Moncayo, which has a Grandeeship attached.
